evidence.quote: Nvidia is in talks to provide roughly $250 billion in financing guarantees for OpenAI as part of a massive data center project, the Wall Street Journal reported ‌on Sunday.
evidence.one_line: Reuters于2026年7月27日报道，援引《华尔街日报》称英伟达正与OpenAI商谈为数据中心项目提供约2500亿美元融资担保。
evidence.speaker: Reuters

evidence.quote: The $250 billion guarantee covers the data center lease ⁠and debt financing, but would not cover the Nvidia chips inside the center, the WSJ said, adding that the chipmaker was also discussing financing OpenAI's chip purchases worth up to $350 billion.
evidence.one_line: Reuters于2026年7月27日援引《华尔街日报》称，约2500亿美元担保涉及数据中心租赁和债务融资、不包括英伟达芯片，并称英伟达还在商谈为OpenAI最高3500亿美元的芯片采购提供融资。
evidence.speaker: Reuters

evidence.quote: The Ohio facility could cost over $500 billion and would be the largest data-center project announced to date, according to the Journal.
evidence.one_line: 《华尔街日报》称，俄亥俄州设施可能耗资超过5000亿美元，并将成为迄今宣布的最大数据中心项目。
evidence.speaker: MarketWatch转述《华尔街日报》

evidence.quote: "I don't know all the details or even how real this is, but if it does happen, I think it's hard to justify for Nvidia," he said.
evidence.one_line: Seaport Research分析师Jay Goldberg表示，他不了解这项安排的全部细节，也不确定其真实性，但若成事，他认为英伟达很难证明其合理性。
evidence.speaker: Seaport Research分析师Jay Goldberg，经MarketWatch引述

evidence.quote: Goldberg noted that companies have previously "tripped themselves up with financing customer purchases."
evidence.one_line: Seaport Research分析师Jay Goldberg指出，企业过去曾因替客户购买提供融资而陷入困境。
evidence.speaker: Seaport Research分析师Jay Goldberg，经MarketWatch引述

evidence.quote: "These kinds of financing usually don't end well," Goldberg added.
evidence.one_line: Seaport Research分析师Jay Goldberg称，这类融资通常没有好结果。
evidence.speaker: Seaport Research分析师Jay Goldberg，经MarketWatch引述

evidence.quote: "Investor feedback late last night was a combination of this being the clearest/largest circular-financing headline we've seen so far and we're not entirely new to this circular-financing debacle," Jefferies technology strategist Jeffrey Favuzza said in a note to clients.
evidence.one_line: Jefferies科技策略师Jeffrey Favuzza在客户报告中称，投资者认为这可能是迄今最清晰、规模最大的循环融资新闻，但市场此前也已见过循环融资问题。
evidence.speaker: Jefferies科技策略师Jeffrey Favuzza

evidence.quote: Nvidia is in talks to provide roughly $250 billion in financing guarantees for OpenAI as part of a massive data center project, the Wall Street Journal reported ‌on Sunday.

The $250 billion guarantee covers the data center lease ⁠and debt financing, but would not cover the Nvidia chips inside the center, the WSJ said, adding that the chipmaker was also discussing financing OpenAI's chip purchases worth up to $350 billion.
The Ohio facility could cost over $500 billion and would be the largest data-center project announced to date, according to the Journal.
"I don't know all the details or even how real this is, but if it does happen, I think it's hard to justify for Nvidia," he said.
Goldberg noted that companies have previously "tripped themselves up with financing customer purchases."
"These kinds of financing usually don't end well," Goldberg added.

"Investor feedback late last night was a combination of this being the clearest/largest circular-financing headline we've seen so far and we're not entirely new to this circular-financing debacle," Jefferies technology strategist Jeffrey Favuzza said in a note to clients.
